# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `alchem docs` from the compiler's own tables. Do not edit: change the documentation in the compiler and run `alchem docs` again. -->

## alchem build

Compile a program to a native executable.

```
alchem build [options] <entry.alc>
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | emit structured compile diagnostics |  |
| `--locked` | fail instead of updating alchem.lock |  |
| `--max-call-depth` | nested Alchem calls allowed per process | `100000` |
| `--o` | output executable |  |
| `--race` | enable Go race detection in generated executable |  |
| `--shutdown-timeout` | runtime shutdown deadline | `2s` |
| `--target` | target GOOS/GOARCH |  |
| `--timeout` | build deadline | `2m0s` |
| `--trace` | include Alchem runtime frames | `true` |

## alchem run

Build a program and run it with the arguments that follow.

```
alchem run [options] <entry.alc> [-- arguments]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--locked` | fail instead of updating alchem.lock |  |
| `--max-call-depth` | nested Alchem calls allowed per process | `100000` |
| `--race` | enable Go race detection in the program |  |
| `--shutdown-timeout` | runtime shutdown deadline | `2s` |
| `--timeout` | build deadline | `2m0s` |

## alchem alx

alx, the Alchem Language Executor: an interactive shell where each input is compiled and run with the definitions and statements before it.

```
alchem alx
```

## alchem lsp

A language server over standard input and output: diagnostics, hover documentation, completion, definitions, symbols and formatting.

```
alchem lsp
```

## alchem new

Create a project: a library module, its test and a main program.

```
alchem new <directory>
```

## alchem check

Report compile errors without building.

```
alchem check [options] <entry.alc>
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | emit structured diagnostics |  |
| `--locked` | fail instead of updating alchem.lock |  |

## alchem fmt

Format .alc files in place.

```
alchem fmt [--check] <path>...
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | check formatting without writing |  |

## alchem test

Run *_test.alc files, with seeds, tags and coverage.

```
alchem test [options] <path>...
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--cover` | report line coverage of the code under test |  |
| `--cover-min` | fail if total coverage is below this percentage |  |
| `--exclude` | leave out tests carrying one of these comma-separated tags |  |
| `--jobs` | test files compiled and run at once; 0 means one per processor |  |
| `--max-failures` | stop a test file after this many failures |  |
| `--only` | run only tests whose name or module contains this text |  |
| `--receive-timeout` | how long assert_receive and refute_receive wait by default | `100ms` |
| `--seed` | seed for test order and random values; 0 picks one |  |
| `--tag` | run only tests carrying one of these comma-separated tags |  |
| `--timeout` | deadline for one fixture, or one test | `30s` |
| `--trace` | print each test with its duration |  |

## alchem syntax

Explain a language construct, with a working example; without a topic, list them.

```
alchem syntax [--all] [--json] [topic]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | print every topic |  |
| `--json` | emit structured output |  |

## alchem doc

Show library documentation, or the documentation written in a file.

```
alchem doc [--all] [--search text] [--json] [Module | Module.function | file.alc]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | print every function of the module in full |  |
| `--json` | emit structured output |  |
| `--search` | find functions, modules and topics containing this text |  |

## alchem agent-guide

Print the guide for coding agents: commands, topics, modules and how to learn more.

```
alchem agent-guide [--json]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | emit structured output |  |

## alchem agent-install

Install a short instruction file that points a coding agent at agent-guide.

```
alchem agent-install [--scope project|user] [--dir path] [--force] [--json] <agent> | --list
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir` | directory to install into instead of the one the scope implies |  |
| `--force` | replace an existing file that differs |  |
| `--json` | emit structured output |  |
| `--list` | list the supported agents |  |
| `--scope` | install for this project, or for the user | `project` |

## alchem docs

Write the generated reference files; --check fails if they are out of date.

```
alchem docs [--check] [--dir path]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | fail if a generated file is out of date, without writing |  |
| `--dir` | directory the reference files are written to | `docs` |

## alchem version

Print the compiler's version and the Go toolchain builds use.

```
alchem version [--json]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | emit structured output |  |
